evals.prompt: Create 4 implementation plans for the Catalogo project: fix critical issues, fix technical debt, remove redundancies, and fix accessibility bugs. Each plan should be in its own file.
evals.expected_output: Exactly four consolidated plan files under docs/ with clear names. No extra report, summary, or snippet files. All plans should be validated against the actual codebase.

evals.prompt: Review the auth callback route in src/app/api/auth/callback/route.ts and propose a secure implementation of the redirect parameter.
evals.expected_output: A secure validation function that rejects protocol-relative URLs, path traversal, URL-encoded bypasses, and dangerous characters. Falls back to /dashboard.

evals.prompt: Refactor product-table.tsx to avoid concurrent delete requests and refresh the table after a delete.
evals.expected_output: An optimistic update with rollback, disabling all delete buttons during the operation, and a single refresh after success.
